dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Not much. I'm just watching this crane on orders from my boss.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Truth be told, there isn't all that much to do. I mean, what's this crane supposed to do, grow legs and run off?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What does this crane do, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: Hey, don't touch it however you like. This contraption isn't something an outsider can use. We boatmen rely on this to help us transport cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: And our boss has said that if anything goes wrong with that crane, our heads will be bolted to it, and...

dialogues.speaker: Zhen Qiang
dialogues.text: ...Well, whatever you do, just don't touch it.
